parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, facility ban, border restriction, or documented police targeting of visitors; same-sex conduct decriminalised in 2023 after rare enforcement. Resident gaps - no legal gender recognition and no stated gender-identity discrimination cover - do not deduct per rubric. Visitor-facing negatives are social: pervasive stigma, conservative attitudes, 2024 election hate speech calling diversity an external deviation, and a 2016 harassment incident for clothing, with no later trans-specific incident documented. Counter-signals are documented acceptance growth, relatively friendly polls, religious-leader support, police protection of Pride and prime-ministerial support, a 2024 trans Miss Universe participant, and welcoming resorts. Limited, discriminatory hospital care is a moderate exposure. This is nontrivial friction with uneven recourse, below acceptance-plus-working-protections, but well above organised targeting or universal exclusion.
